strategy.thesis: Generalist tech VC with a standing, filterable Healthcare vertical on its own portfolio site; spun off its dedicated life-sciences/biotech practice as the independent firm Medicxi in 2016 (already catalogued as eu-medicxi), so Index Ventures' own current health exposure is digital-health / healthcare-services technology rather than therapeutics.

summary.en: London/San Francisco/Geneva multi-stage tech VC (€11.7B AUM, founded 1996) that spun off its dedicated life-sciences practice as the independent firm Medicxi in 2016; retains a standing Healthcare filter on its own portfolio site and has repeatedly led/co-led digital-health and health-services rounds (Alan, Birdie, Kry/Livi) from its generalist tech funds.

strategy.thesis: Sustainability/ESG-focused investment firm (Al Gore, David Blood) running Global Equity, Asia Equity, Growth Equity and Private Equity strategies; not a dedicated health investor, but its Growth Equity strategy has repeatedly backed health-adjacent AI/data infrastructure companies (BenchSci's AI drug-discovery platform, Innovaccer's healthcare-AI platform) as part of its broader sustainability thesis.

summary.en: London-headquartered sustainability/ESG investment firm co-founded by Al Gore and David Blood in 2004; its Growth Equity strategy has led/joined growth rounds in two AI-driven healthcare platforms (BenchSci, Innovaccer), though it has no dedicated health team or fund.
